body.x: Most waste plastic ends up burned or buried, and few people think of it as something that could feed soil. Turning it into a material a farm can use would change where that plastic goes.
MCE Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Construction & Industrial Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Eco-mealworm Lv2: Containerized Industrial System for On-Site Plastic Resource Recovery.

Eco-mealworm Lv2 is a containerized industrial system for on-site plastic resource recovery that reverses the flow of waste plastic, millions of tons of which are incinerated or landfilled every year. With no live insects involved, it runs a mealworm-gut-derived microbial consortium and enzyme system in industrial reactors to open the benzene rings of waste plastic and convert it into a humic substance that revitalizes soil.

In a 100 kg reactor, 40% of pretreated polystyrene is converted within 24 hours, and after 72 hours no residual polystyrene is detectable. Oxygen content rises from about 1% to 43% to 44%, indicating a hydrocarbon transformed into an oxygen-rich humic structure. The humic substance is now undergoing EU REACH registration.

Lv2 is the industrial evolution of Lv1, a CES 2025 Innovation Awards Honoree in which live mealworms consumed styrofoam, and it now scales without insect-rearing infrastructure. The process is designed for hi-cube container modules that install at waste-generating sites and scale out in parallel, returning plastic to farmland rather than to fuel oil.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
